onlyIntervention: Multiply the fitted role-model player offenseResidual by c(K), before training-minute centering and existing shooting projection. Same prior, role defense correction, B1, neutral contests, training-only league constants and engine. c=1 must reproduce v4 exactly. Independent switch c=1 bypasses attenuation.

selection.objective: For each K, minimize absolute difference between arithmetic mean of two development-season calibration slopes and arithmetic mean of their simple slopes. Equal season weight matches A2; slope is actual vs predicted on30 equal-weight teams, after averaging20 paired seeds. No RMSE/win/player-error selection.
selection.mapping: Piecewise linear interpolation of the centered30-team prediction vectors in c between actual20-seed anchors, separately within season; derive nonlinear calibration slope from interpolated vectors. Search deterministic10001-point c grid within[0,1], then refine the best adjacent grid interval by80 golden-section iterations. Ties choose larger c (minimum intervention). Round finalc to6 decimals, rerun20 seeds per development season once. No after-validation c adjustment, even if achieved slope differs from interpolation.
selection.nonlinearity: At c=.5 compare observed centered net vector against midpoint of c=0 and1, report RMS discrepancy, difference relative to endpoint response RMS, and predicted-vs-observed pooled slope. c(K) is not the oracle team-scale ratio. Non-monotonic/unreachable objective is reported, not fixed by team-specific knobs.
selection.calibration: Use the exact frozen v4 training-only pooled moment update method separately for each c (3 seeds20260101–03, at most5 evaluated iterations); same estimator/rules, not identical numeric constants. No heldout league correction.
selection.personalGate: Development minute-weighted FG percentage-point MAE must be <= v3+0.3 in all six season/cutoff cells to call v5 a player-card estimator; otherwise it is team-strength only. Never adjust c to pass this gate.

blindEvaluation.interpretation: All verdicts use joint franchise+seed bootstrap only. No old B1 temporal slope rule and no old C2 two-cutoff pass criterion.

jointBootstrap.franchiseCoupling: Same franchise sample shared across all seasons and all versions; same paired seed sample shared across seasons. Recenter net within each season. Seasons equally weighted; netRMSE/winRMSE pool MSE then sqrt; other metrics arithmetic mean.

blindEvaluation.strongerComparator: For each K/group and each error metric, evaluation envelope=min(combined simple error,combined shrink error); recompute the envelope within each joint bootstrap draw. Both fixed predictors individually also reported. No choice enters engine forecasts.
blindEvaluation.verdict: At each K using only the two blind seasons combined: 成立 if either primary error (netRMSE or winMAE) has jointCI upper<0. Report any significant worsening of the other error as a tradeoff. 不成立 if neither improves and at least one has jointCI lower>0. 分不出 if both intervals include0, and report both widths. Also report each endpoint verdict. No point-estimate claims when 分不出; no K pooling or new majority threshold.
blindEvaluation.primaryReport: Four-season combined, alongside blind-two-season combined; only blind-two-season combined establishes C4. Single seasons descriptive. No refitting/version changes after seeing blind results.
blindEvaluation.C5: Compute actual-vs-predicted calibration-slope ratios v4/simple and v3/simple in each new season/cutoff, compare descriptively to developer-season values; oracle ratios are never forecast inputs.
